updates.title: CVE-2026-69851: Microsoft Entra ID Elevation of Privilege via SSRF
updates.summary: A server-side request forgery vulnerability in Azure Active Directory allows an authorized attacker to escalate privileges over the network. Admins should prioritize patching to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation in identity systems.

updates.title: CVE-2026-69836: Microsoft Entra ID Remote Code Execution via Deserialization
updates.summary: Unsafe deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Entra ID enables unauthorized remote code execution over the network. This is a critical vulnerability affecting the core identity platform and requires immediate attention.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Policy Sync SLA Reduced to 30 Minutes
updates.summary: Microsoft is accelerating policy synchronization in Purview Data Loss Prevention, cutting the sync window from 2 hours to 30 minutes. This means compliance protections take effect faster across your organization, reducing the window where older policies remain active.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Block Sensitive Data in Copilot External Web Search
updates.summary: DLP policies now prevent Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from using sensitive organizational data in external web searches. This launched feature reduces data exfiltration risk when users leverage AI assistants for research and web-based tasks.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Policy Tips Now Available in Outlook for Mac
updates.summary: DLP policy tips are now available on macOS Outlook, providing real-time in-mail notifications when users attempt to send emails containing policy-violating sensitive data. Users can remove non-compliant recipients or request policy overrides before sending.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Policy Tips Now Available in Outlook Mobile
updates.summary: DLP now provides real-time policy tip alerts on Outlook mobile clients, helping users avoid accidentally sharing sensitive data on phones and tablets. This extends compliance protections to mobile workers outside the office.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Security Investigations: Analyze Endpoint DLP Alert Files
updates.summary: Data Security Investigations now integrates with endpoint DLP alerts, automatically gathering related files that triggered alerts for faster analysis of potential data exfiltration. This reduces investigation time for SOC teams reviewing compromised content.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Archive SharePoint Files Under Retention
updates.summary: Administrators can now include file archiving actions in SharePoint Online retention policies, moving inactive content to low-cost storage while maintaining discoverability and compliance. This provides a third option beyond retention and deletion for cost-effective data governance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Retention Policies for Copilot Memory
updates.summary: Retention policies can now be applied to Microsoft 365 Copilot memory items stored in Exchange mailboxes, enabling admins to preserve historical memory versions for compliance and investigation purposes. This extends lifecycle management governance to AI-generated user context data.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Hard Delete for OneDrive and SharePoint via Priority Cleanup
updates.summary: Administrators can now configure hard delete workflows in Data Lifecycle Management for OneDrive and SharePoint content, permanently removing files after the 93-day recycle bin retention period to meet strict compliance deletion requirements. This feature requires three separate administrative approvals to prevent accidental data loss.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Retention Based on Last Accessed Date
updates.summary: Retention policies can now trigger based on when files in SharePoint or OneDrive were last accessed by users, enabling more granular lifecycle management based on actual usage patterns. This helps organizations retain active content while removing stale data more intelligently.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Security Triage Agent: Confidence Scores and Reasoning Traces
updates.summary: The Data Security Triage Agent in DLP now surfaces confidence scores and reasoning traces alongside agent decisions, allowing analysts to understand why the agent made specific choices. This transparency helps SOC teams trust automation and reduces unnecessary manual review of agent-triaged alerts.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Sensitivity Labels: Simulation Mode for Auto-Labeling Policies
updates.summary: Before enforcing auto-labeling policies, admins can now run them in simulation mode to preview which items would be labeled and review match results without making actual changes. The new Insights tab provides at-a-glance performance metrics for policy tuning.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Integration with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to inspect and protect sensitive data at the network layer, including text and AI interactions in browsers, apps, and APIs. This prevents data leakage to untrusted cloud apps and generative AI platforms through network-level enforcement.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Classification Failure Detection for Exchange Online
updates.summary: Exchange Online DLP policies can now detect when classification fails due to timeouts or throttling, allowing admins to configure specific protection actions for different failure types via the DocumentScanFailures condition. This improves DLP reliability and visibility into scanning issues.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Three-Approval Requirement for Priority Cleanup
updates.summary: Priority cleanup policies now require three separate approvals before permanent deletion: from a Priority Cleanup administrator, a retention manager, and an eDiscovery administrator. This strengthens governance controls over irreversible deletion of organizational content.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Sensitivity Labels: Auto-Labeling Can Remove or Downgrade Labels
updates.summary: Auto-labeling policies can now remove or downgrade existing sensitivity labels on content, providing more flexible label lifecycle management. This capability helps organizations adjust classifications as document context or sensitivity levels change.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62827: Microsoft SharePoint Server Elevation of Privilege via Improper Authentication
updates.summary: An improper authentication flaw in Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to escalate privileges over the network. This vulnerability affects on-premises SharePoint deployments and requires timely patching.

updates.title: CVE-2026-63512: Microsoft SharePoint Server Tampering via Incorrect Authorization
updates.summary: Incorrect authorization in Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to tamper with content over the network. Organizations should verify file integrity and audit recent modifications in SharePoint environments.
